speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development (a) what is the latest available number of infant and childcare places; and (b) what is the current ratio of infant and childcare places to resident children below seven years old, as broken down by planning areas.

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: Just one supplementary question for the Minister of State.

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: But for places where there is a relatively higher proportion of younger residents such as in Sengkang and Punggol, I think the utilisation will be rather high.

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: I also understand, at least based on the centres set to open in 2025, that a lot of them are naturally in some of these new towns.

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: So, how is this ratio going to change with the introduction of additional new childcare places in the next five years that the Ministry has announced?

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: Especially if you look at Sengkang, based on a quick check on the Life SG app, if I look at infant care places within one kilometre of Sengkang Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) station, for example, a large percentage of those are full or have limited vacancies.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: ECDA would assess the sites that are available.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: HDB gives them a heads-up so that they are able to assess the void deck space that is available or where there are adjacent places available, to be able to construct a space that can be used for infant care and childcare centres.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: We have one last question to be answered.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Mr Yip Hon Weng, please move the next question.
